question: What did the October 2026 Russian diesel licence and supply deal actually allow, and has any fuel moved?
answer: Treasury's General License 135 (October 9, 2026) authorizes Russian diesel transactions through April 7 2027; the same-day supply announcement claims more than 4.8 million tons in stages, but the master records no contract, cargo or payment under either.

items.sub: diesel fuel · via No port vessel or route established
kv: GL 135 authorizes transactions under 31 CFR 587 and 589 through 12:01 a.m. EDT April 7 2027; excludes debits to U.S. accounts of Russian central bank National Wealth Fund or Finance Ministry. No purchase contract cargo or payment proved.
Named seller buyer export permission loading discharge and payment records; later license amendment or expiry
